# Phase Three — Final Critique and Thirty-Five Further Improvements

The Awtsmoos is not contained by first insight or second; Awtsmoos.com lets the third pass cut through attractive abstractions until only verified social contracts remain.

1. Read every first-wave target completely before rewrite.
2. Trace constructor call sites outside Social Hub before changing paths.
3. Trace all direct `app.*` property consumers before changing facade fields.
4. Preserve root DOM IDs and data attributes during architecture work.
5. Keep assembly modules free of user-flow business logic.
6. Keep lifecycle coordinator free of DOM rendering details.
7. Keep context presenter synchronous and side-effect limited to its owned elements.
8. Keep identity transition coordinator the only authority for alias-scoped refresh fan-out.
9. Add a monotonic identity generation so old async completions can be ignored.
10. Do not abort public loads that do not depend on alias.
11. Return structured refresh results so status can report partial failure honestly.
12. Separate 'initialized' from 'loaded for current identity'.
13. Ensure state change rendering cannot throw and kill the subscriber chain silently.
14. Preserve one render pass after initialization.
15. Avoid creating coordinator cycles back into `HubApp` if narrower callbacks suffice.
16. Make route loaders a declarative manifest only after their signatures are verified.
17. Do not retrofit all panels to a base class unless genuine shared lifecycle exists.
18. Prefer composition for panel capabilities.
19. Add operation state only to mutations that need optimistic UI.
20. Keep failed mutation records bounded/clearable.
21. Ensure operation keys include entity identity to prevent cross-row collisions.
22. Normalize alias IDs at API/state boundaries once, not independently in every view.
23. Relationship state should be immutable snapshots in rendering paths.
24. Discovery pagination should guard duplicate pages and stale mode responses.
25. Search should cancel prior queries on new input.
26. Debounce is not a substitute for cancellation.
27. Inbox unread counters should derive from event records, not separate drifting integers.
28. Message unread counters should derive from conversation state where possible.
29. Realtime events should carry dedupe keys or be deduped by stable server IDs.
30. Reconnect must stop when the user changes identity or leaves the relevant live surface if transport ownership requires it.
31. Composer retries must not duplicate successful server creations.
32. Media upload state must distinguish validation rejection, transport failure, cancellation, and server rejection.
33. Accessibility assertions should be added to surface tests for busy/pressed/expanded relationships.
34. Documentation examples must use the same public APIs that production imports.
35. Final browser verification must check narrow/mobile/desktop, focus restoration, zero horizontal document overflow, and console/network errors without claiming unsupported adapter evidence.

## Final decision

First write only assembly/lifecycle/context decomposition after full reads and call-site tracing. Then test. Then use the newly explicit boundaries to drive the next social feature wave.
